reason: Static review of the frozen E045 helper and E075 V2 conformance preregistration showed that legacy E045 evaluates consecutive adjacency and the lexicographic tie-break in score-ranked combination order rather than on the sorted ticket. E075 V2 defines the corrected sorted-ticket semantics. E079 must isolate the structural objective, not perpetuate that known ordering defect.
corrected_baseline_semantics: For each six-number subset enumerated from the score-ranked top-16 pool, sort the subset ascending before counting consecutive adjacent pairs and before lexicographic tie-break; return the sorted ticket. This is the E075 V2 conformance correction.
challenger_semantics: Keep the identical E054 scores and top-16 pool; select the six highest scores only, with number-ascending score ties; no odd/even, low/high, consecutive, or band terms.

versioning.v1_status: PRESERVED_NOT_EXECUTED; superseded due to pre-run source-order conformance review and initialization defect.
